item.title: 2012 Mercedes-Benz C250 Sport Sedan at No Reserve
item.description: This 2012 Mercedes-Benz C250 Sport sedan is powered by a turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-four linked with a seven-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Iridium Silver Metallic over Gray MB-Tex. Equipment includes a sunroof, 18" AMG seven-spoke alloy wheels, power-adjustable front sport seats, a CD stereo, cruise control, dual-zone automatic climate control, a rearview camera, and COMAND with navigation. This W204 C250 has 107k miles and is now offered by the selling dealer at no reserve

item.description: This 1988 Mercedes-Benz 560SL is said to have remained in storage from 1999 until 2019, and it was listed on BaT in November 2019, and again in April 2020, before it was later acquired by the current owner. The car is finished in Arctic White over Medium Red leather and is powered by a 5.5-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. item.title: 1986 Chevrolet C20 Suburban Silverado 7.4L
item.description: This 1986 Chevrolet C20 Suburban is a Silverado 4x2 that has been registered in California since new, and it shows 94k miles. The truck is finished in Canyon Copper and Indian Bronze Metallic over Saddle Tan cloth, and it is powered by a 7.4-liter V8 paired with a three-speed automatic. Details include towing equipment, 16" steel wheels, front bucket seats, power windows and locks, air conditioning, and a cassette stereo. item.description: This 1963 Chevrolet Corvette split-window coupe is a custom build from Jeff Hayes Customs in Indiana that was completed in 2025, and it is comprised of a Daytona Blue body mounted to a fabricated Art Morrison chassis. The 6.2-liter LS3 V8 is linked with a four-speed automatic transmission and a reinforced solid rear axle.
